points: Co-sealed by FBI, CISA, NSA, UK NCSC and agencies from Australia, Canada, Japan, New Zealand and Spain (AA26-281A)
EBurst tool sprays passwords against ten Exchange/Office 365 interfaces; DCSync copies AD data
Mitigations: MFA for webmail, VPN and critical systems; monitor unexpected AD replication

src.name: FBI, CISA, NSA, NCSC and partners

take: A joint advisory shows state-linked actors winning with credentials, not exotic exploits: password spraying on Exchange and Microsoft 365, then DCSync. Enforce MFA on webmail and VPN.
title: Nine agencies: China-linked group sprays passwords and copies Active Directory
